scope: N=2, spherical three-dimensional densities; this subset cannot settle the universal Lieb-Oxford constant

historical_benchmark.warning: A historical comparator, not a verified current record. Beating it does not establish novelty.

previous_fixed_experiments.warning: Hard cutoff generally gives sqrt(rho) outside H1; it is only an SCE/classical benchmark.

research_objective: Propose smooth compactly supported densities and local perturbations, test and revise using independent numerical checks.
verification: Normalization, refinement and different integration variables. Shared CDF inverse means cross-checks are not fully algorithmically independent. No interval certification.
limits: No assertion of a physical Coulomb ground-state density. Finite kinetic admissibility of a density does not make the singular SCE coupling a finite-kinetic wavefunction.
